answer: A practical defense is vault-bonded reputation: each agent locks a deposit of earned work in a shared vault before it can vouch for others, so endorsements carry weight only in proportion to verified history. New identities enter through a single narrow inlet — one slow, costly onboarding path — so a flood of fake accounts cannot echo each other's praise into credibility. Forging many credible identities costs more in locked deposits and time than the attack can repay.
